item.title: Bulletin updated at 09:15 HKT 09/Feb/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A strong northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China today, it will be rather cool in the morning over the region. A band of clouds will cover Guangdong today and tomorrow. The monsoon will moderate progressively and temperatures over southern China will rise midweek this week. A fresh easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.
